name: omnimemory
description: Local-first engineering memory capture for AI-era development workflows.

omniMemory.databasePath.description: Workspace-relative path for the local SQLite database.

omniMemory.memoryDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory where Markdown memory cards are written.

omniMemory.defaultConversationTool.description: Source label used when the active editor text is captured as a conversation.

omniMemory.conversationImportMaxCharacte.description: Maximum characters imported from clipboard or transcript files.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorProvider.description: Memory synthesis provider. Heuristic is offline; openai uses the Responses API; command runs a local command that reads JSON context from stdin and outputs JSON.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorOpenAIModel.description: OpenAI model used when memoryGeneratorProvider is openai.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorOpenAIEndpoint.description: OpenAI Responses API endpoint used when memoryGeneratorProvider is openai.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorOpenAIApiKeyEn.description: Environment variable containing the OpenAI API key.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorCommand.description: Local command used when memoryGeneratorProvider is command. It receives JSON context on stdin and must output the memory JSON schema.

omniMemory.memoryGeneratorMaxInputCharac.description: Maximum characters sent to an LLM-backed memory generator.

omniMemory.maxDiffCharacters.description: Maximum number of Git diff characters included in memory synthesis.

omniMemory.enableCommitDetection.description: Prompt to generate an OmniMemory card when a new Git commit is detected.

omniMemory.commitDetectionIntervalSecond.description: Polling interval used to detect new Git commits.

omniMemory.verificationCommand.description: Default local command used by OmniMemory verification.

omniMemory.maxVerificationOutputCharacte.description: Maximum command output characters stored as verification evidence.

omniMemory.enableDiagnosticSimilaritySea.description: Automatically search OmniMemory when the active editor has errors or warnings.

omniMemory.diagnosticSimilarityMinScore.description: Minimum local relevance score required before OmniMemory suggests a similar memory for diagnostics.

omniMemory.diagnosticSimilarityDebounceM.description: Debounce delay before searching memories for active editor diagnostics.
